_public_export.scope: Historical claims and verification records retain their original scope. Priority 1 cyclicity is even L2 only; full-ground capture and RH remain open.

success_scope: Exact conditional theorem stack, normalization, explicit missing comparison proposition, and independent failure tests; no new global confinement bound.
p_adic_scope: Kurlberg II: specified Weil-representation vectors, odd residue characteristic. Sauvalle: specified nondegenerate quadratic characters with weak Mellin transforms, including Q_2. Not arbitrary local test functions.
sauvalle_gap: The adelic weak Mellin transform equals the actual global L-function times explicit local corrections. For the Q example, off-critical-line zeros are preserved with multiplicity; global confinement is RH-equivalent.
semilocal_stability_scope: Bounded Sonin-space isomorphism and Fourier intertwining; same completed Mellin functions with S-dependent norms. Not a universal real-zero or ground-state stability theorem.
finite_prime_real_zero_property_scope: KNOWN CONDITIONAL ON ES: simple lowest eigenvalue and even ground vector of the actual finite Weil matrix.
preceding_three_flags_scope: Actual normalized Weil-ground / determinant family, not the separate prolate proxy.
proxy_estimate: For each 0<r<1/2: sup_{|Im z|<=r}|khat_lambda(z)-X(z)/4| <= C_r*lambda^(-1/2+r)+C_r*lambda^(C_r)*exp(-pi*lambda^2), in the printed h and du/u conventions.
new_external_input_scope: Explicit CCM Lemmas 7.2-7.3 prolate/Hermite and proxy-transform estimates, not previously quantified in the old audit, were incorporated. Theorem 5.10, CvS Theorem 6.1, and the two Section 8 missing steps were already recorded in research/notes/accumulation_spectrum.md section 4 and are reused, not new inputs. No novelty claim.
exact_break_proposition: G*: There exists an ES-admissible sequence (lambda_j,N_j), lambda_j -> infinity, such that for every compact K contained in Omega, sup_K |vhat(lambda_j,N_j;z)/vhat(lambda_j,N_j;z_star) - khat_lambda_j(z)/khat_lambda_j(z_star)| -> 0. ES and the comparison estimate are both unproved obligations.
necessary_parameter_condition: N_j/log(lambda_j) -> infinity; otherwise untouched Dirac-tail zeros force any locally uniform holomorphic limit to vanish identically.
failure_tests: Actual N=0 family: real zeros and fixed nonreal normalization do not imply local boundedness or normality.
Norm-resolvent convergence need not imply the intended determinant limit without high-spectrum tail control.
Sonin-space stability does not imply actual ground-state or Weil positivity stability.
Local zero-free factors do not transfer the confinement property through an Euler product outside its convergence domain.
Finite simplicity can be lost in an infinite limit.
Raw determinant comparison requires a nonconstant phase correction as well as scalar normalization.
independent_audit_scope: Core normalization, necessary parameter condition, N=0 counterexample, Hurwitz/Rouche logic, and selected local algebra independently checked; not a second full proof of every cited source.
reopening_condition: Independent arithmetic control of ES on a cofinal sequence and normalized actual-ground/prolate comparison, or an estimate sufficient for that comparison. Do not substitute more finite zero matching.
